about: Workers who travel between each pair of municipios of Puerto Rico, whether a timetabled route or a público route of the 2020 list joins the pair, and the simulated connections drawn for the pairs with many workers and no timetabled route. A simulated connection is not a proposed route or a demand forecast (transit_links.py, docs/transit-links.md).

flows.source: US Census Bureau, County-to-County Commuting Flows, American Community Survey 2016-2020 (5-year), Table 1
flows.moe: 90 percent margin of error; for a pair, the root of the sum of the squares of the two directions

timetables.source: GTFS timetables of the ATI and the municipal systems, as the observatory publishes them (trips.json, operators.json)
timetables.rule: A route with stops in both municipios on a weekday, Saturday or Sunday; direct routes only

publicos.source: Instituto de Estadísticas de Puerto Rico, Mapa de rutas de porteadores públicos (Autoridad de Carreteras y Transportación)

rules.low: margin of error as large as the estimate or larger

traffic.source: FHWA Highway Performance Monitoring System (traffic_roads.geojson, traffic.py)
traffic.rule: Points every 100 m along each simulated connection; a point takes the count of the counted road within 25 m. aadt_med is the median of those counts, aadt_max the highest, counted_pct the share of points on a counted road.

safety.source: NHTSA Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS), Puerto Rico files (crashes.py)
safety.rule: People killed in fatal crashes within 100 m of the simulated connection's line over the five years; walk_bike_5y counts the pedestrians and bicyclists among them. A crash at a crossing road within 100 m counts too.

transit_time.source: The published weekday timetables (trips.json), as the observatory reads them on weekday (typical Wednesday service)
transit_time.rule: The fastest journey by timetable between the two town centres, in either direction, leaving every 15 minutes from 6:00 to 9:00 on a weekday: walking up to 1 km to and from a stop and up to 400 m between stops (straight line times 1.3, at 1.2 m/s, plus 2 minutes to transfer); tt_best is the fastest, tt_typ the median over the departures (waiting included), tt_xfers the transfers on the fastest. No journey over 3 hours.

why.1: a town centre has no stop of the weekday timetables within 1 km
why.2: no journey within 3 hours joins the two centres

residents.rule: Residents of the 2020 Census blocks whose point is within 1 km of the connection's line; along_far, those of them beyond 400 m in a straight line of a scheduled stop. Connections share roads, so the counts must not be added up.

bridges.rule: Bridges whose point is within 50 m of the connection's line: bridges_poor in poor condition, bridges_closed closed. A bridge under the road the line follows can count too.

need.source: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020-2024 (5-year): households with no vehicle (B25044, economy_series.json) and residents below the poverty level (B17001, housing_series.json)
